## Abilities and when they are learned

The learn level is the first level the bot can have the ability: a trainer, starting, quest or item level from `kit.yaml`, or the talent point in the build above.

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **WT00u-wizard-oil — Apply Brilliant Wizard Oil:** The spec's own guide page names it (line 200); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **WT00u-greater-firepower — Use Elixir of Greater Firepower:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elixir of Greater Firepower (item 21546, required level 40), elixir or potion (aura 26276 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 201); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **WT00u-tea — Use Nordanaar Herbal Tea:** Restores 525 health and 810 mana (spell 19398, instant) and shares its 120 s category 1172 with the Dark and Demonic Runes; the guide names it as the mana cooldown beside the potions.
- **WT00u-greater-arcane — Use Greater Arcane Elixir:** HO-TKB-PLAY-345 (consumables for mage and warlock, orchestrator ruling 2026-10-18: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold or reachable gets a use rule so the kit carries it): Greater Arcane Elixir (item 13454, required level 47, vendor-sold, DB tkbplay-345), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and its buff is missing (the elixirs of this page stack with each other, the aura guard is the item's own).
- **WT00u-shadow-power — Use Elixir of Shadow Power:** HO-TKB-PLAY-345 (consumables for mage and warlock, orchestrator ruling 2026-10-18: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold or reachable gets a use rule so the kit carries it): Elixir of Shadow Power (item 9264, required level 40, vendor-sold, DB tkbplay-345), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and its buff is missing (the elixirs of this page stack with each other, the aura guard is the item's own).
- **WT00u-dreamshard — Use Dreamshard Elixir:** HO-TKB-PLAY-345 (consumables for mage and warlock, orchestrator ruling 2026-10-18: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold or reachable gets a use rule so the kit carries it): Dreamshard Elixir (item 61224, required level 46, vendor-sold, DB tkbplay-345), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and its buff is missing (the elixirs of this page stack with each other, the aura guard is the item's own).
- **WT00u-dreamtonic — Use Dreamtonic:** HO-TKB-PLAY-345 (consumables for mage and warlock, orchestrator ruling 2026-10-18: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold or reachable gets a use rule so the kit carries it): Dreamtonic (item 61423, required level 50, vendor-sold, DB tkbplay-345), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and its buff is missing (the elixirs of this page stack with each other, the aura guard is the item's own).
- **WT00u-juju-flurry — Use Juju Flurry:** HO-TKB-PLAY-345 (consumables for mage and warlock, orchestrator ruling 2026-10-18: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold or reachable gets a use rule so the kit carries it): Juju Flurry (item 12450, required level 55, vendor-sold, DB tkbplay-345), burst: in combat on a boss target, its buff aura not on (the same shape as the HO-219 Juju Flurry rules).
- **WT00u-potion-of-quickness — Use Potion of Quickness:** HO-TKB-PLAY-345 (consumables for mage and warlock, orchestrator ruling 2026-10-18: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold or reachable gets a use rule so the kit carries it): Potion of Quickness (item 61181, required level 50, vendor-sold, DB tkbplay-345), burst: in combat on a boss target, its buff aura not on (the same shape as the HO-219 Juju Flurry rules).
- **WT00c-unending-breath-pre-swim — Unending Breath:** HO-TKB-PLAY-144 (round 131 BFD-C, p4-pioneer water.py: party uptime submerged 77.6%, the shaman's 18 Water Breathing casts spread 4/4/4/3/3 with 4 on a druid already in Aquatic Form while the mage was covered 35.6% of her time underwater): at a swim stretch (party.swim_ahead, p4-group 343) every member enters with at least five minutes of Unending Breath: a buff placed for an earlier stretch ran out in the next one.
- **WT00b-unending-breath — Unending Breath:** HO-TKB-PLAY-144 (round 131 BFD-C, p4-pioneer water.py: party uptime submerged 77.6%, the shaman's 18 Water Breathing casts spread 4/4/4/3/3 with 4 on a druid already in Aquatic Form while the mage was covered 35.6% of her time underwater): covered_by [131, 1066] (v30): a member in Aquatic Form or carrying the other breath buff is skipped. HO-TKB-PLAY-139 (owner, 2026-10-08: the party's shaman or warlock buffs every member before a swim and refreshes it while the party is underwater; druids use Aquatic Form for their own swims): Unending Breath (5697, instant, 10 min, 30 yd) on every member, the resident included, who lacks it or has under two minutes left (party_missing with refresh_below_ms, v28), while the party walks or holds at a swim stretch (party.swim_ahead, p4-group 343) or any member is submerged; in combat too, since a buff running out mid-fight underwater is how a member drowns.
- **WT00d-demonic-sacrifice — Demonic Sacrifice:** HO-TKB-PLAY-276 (amp-3 draft rot-mage-warlock.patch of 2026-10-18, rebased by tkb-play onto main with HO-270..274; the amp-3 text follows): THE 11-POINT DIP'S PAYOFF, WHICH NO RULE IN THIS FILE EVER COLLECTED (spec audit 2026-10-18, gap destro-1: the tree's whole reason for dipping Demonology is "sacrifice the Imp for +4% spell damage, plus Soul Entrapment's +6% with no demon out" -- guide/classes/warlock/destruction.md L73, L54 -- and no rotation cast it). Same shape as the affliction rule: party only, out of combat, pet alive, `not aura_self(18789)` (Burning Wish, +3% damage for 30 minutes at the pin -- spell row L14724; the guide's text says 4% and the row wins), and WT01a-summon-imp carries the matching term so the sacrificed Imp is not summoned back.
- **WT00t-voidstone — Use Voidstone:** Item 51936, on-use 52751, -11 threat for 30 minutes (rows L18607/L27208), applied in combat when `target.threat_pct >= 85`; above WT00t-firestone so the walk takes the threat stone first and the two do not trade auras (`not aura_self(52751)` here, and the firestone rule also refuses while 52751 is up).
- **WT01c-summon-succubus — Summon Succubus:** HO-TKB-PLAY-276 (amp-3 draft rot-mage-warlock.patch of 2026-10-18, rebased by tkb-play onto main with HO-270..274; the amp-3 text follows with the tkb-play gate: Level 60 only: the levelling guide keeps the Voidwalker as the solo demon until 60 (leveling.md L205, L221, L244, L270); the Succubus and the Felhunter are the 60 choices of the spec page.): The missing Succubus, the same gate as the other two files (alone, healthy, a Soul Shard, out of combat): level 20 from the guide's table ("More damage than the Voidwalker but squishy. No party case: the Imp rule is the party pet and this spec sacrifices it anyway (WT00d above).
- **WT01e-summon-felhunter — Summon Felhunter:** HO-TKB-PLAY-276 (amp-3 draft rot-mage-warlock.patch of 2026-10-18, rebased by tkb-play onto main with HO-270..274; the amp-3 text follows with the tkb-play gate: Level 60 only: the levelling guide keeps the Voidwalker as the solo demon until 60 (leveling.md L205, L221, L244, L270); the Succubus and the Felhunter are the 60 choices of the spec page.): The Felhunter, and for THIS spec the guide names it twice as the mana answer: "Before the pull: sacrifice the Imp, or the Felhunter if mana is your limit" (guide/classes/warlock/destruction.md L23) and "Fire burns more mana than the other specs. No demon out, mana under 35 per cent, a Soul Shard held, level 30 (kit; "~30 Felhunter", leveling.md L294).
- **WT01-demon-armor — Demon Armor:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **WT01d-summon-voidwalker-solo — Summon Voidwalker:** HO-TKB-PLAY-031 (orchestrator, round-47 delta-0 split): ALONE, from level 10, the Voidwalker is the levelling pet (guide: "Voidwalker, with Torment on autocast"; "Send the Voidwalker"; "the general leveling pet"). An Imp that is alive is not replaced: the pet predicates do not say which demon it is, so the Voidwalker comes when the Imp has died or been dismissed.
- **WT01a-summon-imp — Summon Imp:** THE WARLOCK HAD NO PET AT ALL, IN ANY OF ITS THREE ROTATIONS, AND A WARLOCK WITHOUT A DEMON IS NOT A WARLOCK. The Imp is the one this rule summons and the archive decides it, not preference: "every common-demon summon except Imp costs a Soul Shard", so the Imp is the only demon a bot can re-summon without a resource the vocabulary cannot see; the Voidwalker is explicitly not an answer -- "Attempting to use the demon as a tank: Voidwalker threat does not scale and consistently loses aggro even at higher character levels" -- and a dungeon party already has a warrior tank; and the Imp is the one that does damage at range (Firebolt) and carries Blood Pact for the party, which the archive prices by naming its loss a mistake ("Letting the Imp die to AoE and losing Blood Pact").
- **WT01b-health-funnel — Health Funnel:** 004 removed its Health Funnel because its only available guard was `not aura_self(6307)`, which is FALSE exactly while the Imp is alive and hurt -- the one state in which funnelling helps -- and TRUE while there is no pet to funnel to; from priority 14 that would have spent every in-combat tick above 70 per cent health. The reason is gone: `pet.exists`, `pet.alive` and `pet.hp_pct` are state-vocabulary v3 predicates implemented in Expr.cpp, so the rule can now ask the question it always needed to ask.
- **WT00s-caster-first-10499 — Shadow Bolt:** Its spell list (tkbplay-201.result.txt: 104990, Wail of Souls 17631, 7,580-8,059 hp, level 58-60) is instant and not interruptible per p4-group (spell_template: castingTimeIndex 1, interruptFlags 0; not re-read here), so no interrupt rule can answer it and killing it is the only kit answer; same shape and gates as the 10471 rule, just ahead of it.
- **WT02-life-tap — Life Tap:** This rule carried NO combat gate, and out of combat that put it in a loop with the drink rule above it: WA00-drink is gated on `not aura_self(432)`, so once the drink aura is up the drink rule is FALSE and this rule takes the tick -- converting health to mana that the drink is already refilling for free. MEASURED on d-20260917T141056Z-pop: 293 Life Tap pushes on Corvane, 179 of them (61 per cent) OUT OF COMBAT, and 120 of those 179 with the Drink aura 432 already on the warlock; 586 CAST_START for 293 pushes.
- **WT00s-peel-11197 — Shadow Bolt:** Other Stratholme Undead adds are not sourced.
- **WT00s-caster-first-10471 — Shadow Bolt:** Mana Burn 17615 is instant and not interruptible (CastingTimeIndex 1, interruptFlags 0), so killing the caster is the only kit answer. amp-4's own count: the Acolyte/Neophyte pair is the killer in 149 of 263 deaths, but only 3 of 42 windows were kill-order-limited, so this is the orchestrator's ask, not the largest lever.
- **WT00s-caster-first-10470 — Shadow Bolt:** Mana Burn 17615 is instant and not interruptible (CastingTimeIndex 1, interruptFlags 0), so killing the caster is the only kit answer. amp-4's own count: the Acolyte/Neophyte pair is the killer in 149 of 263 deaths, but only 3 of 42 windows were kill-order-limited, so this is the orchestrator's ask, not the largest lever.
- **WT02a-pet-attack — pet attack:** HO-TKB-PLAY-048 (orchestrator, p4-group 123; HO-P4-GROUP-123 read round 79): send the pet at the resident's target once the fight is on, and again on a target change (pet.attacking is true only when the pet's victim is MY target). A defensive player pet ignores its owner's attack while it is out of combat (PetAI::OwnerAttacked returns when the pet is not in combat and its owner is a player), so with no rule that sends it in it fought only what hit it or its owner: on the tank's target on 84 of 169 in-combat ticks in round 79.
- **WT03-shadow-ward — Shadow Ward:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **WT04-fear — Fear:** Fear at under 35 per cent health is a way out of a fight that is being lost; against a mob at 30 per cent or less the way out is to finish it, which a DoT tick or one more bolt does while a Fear only gives it eight seconds to come back at full strength.
- **WT05a-soul-fire — Soul Fire:** HO-TKB-PLAY-276 (amp-3 draft rot-mage-warlock.patch of 2026-10-18, rebased by tkb-play onto main with HO-270..274; the amp-3 text follows with the tkb-play gate: Soul Fire costs a Soul Shard per cast (DB 6353, reagent 6265) and the shards also pay the Voidwalker resummons (leveling.md L283), so it is cast on an elite or a boss target only): THE GUIDE'S PRIORITY NUMBER ONE AND THE FILE'S BIGGEST HOLE: "Improved Soul Fire buff missing and Soul Fire ready -> Soul Fire. THE BUFF IS 51735 in our DB: "Improved Soul Fire" carries `effectApplyAuraName1 79` (damage done) with basePoints 9, durationIndex 9, and Soul Fire casts it on itself -- so `not aura_self(51735)` is exactly "the buff is missing" as the guide's priority line words it.
- **WT05-conflagrate — Conflagrate:** The `aura_target(348)` guard is the rule's whole shape: Conflagrate consumes the Immolate below it, so it is only worth its 165 mana when WT08 has already landed, and that is a condition v2 can state exactly.
- **WT07b-curse-of-the-elements — Curse of the Elements:** HO-TKB-PLAY-276 (amp-3 draft rot-mage-warlock.patch of 2026-10-18, rebased by tkb-play onto main with HO-270..274; the amp-3 text follows): THE FIRE SPEC'S ASSIGNED CURSE, which the class had no rule for (spec audit gap destro-5): the guide's SM/Ruin line names the shape ("curse (Malediction adds Curse of Agony) -> Corruption -> Shadow Bolt", guide/classes/warlock/destruction.md L154) and the same page's build advice is fire, where the curse that pays is Elements -- "Curse of the Elements" reduces fire and frost resistance by 46 at rank 1 in our row (effectBasePoints1 -46, misc 20 = fire|frost), which is what "Fire" means for this file's Immolate, Searing Pain, Conflagrate, Soul Fire and Hellfire. 100 mana at rank 1; 32 is the kit's level for 1490 (the leveling page agrees: "Curse of the Elements is trainable at 32").
- **WT07-curse-of-agony — Curse of Agony:** Destruction has no curse talents, so this is here for its mana efficiency and nothing else.
- **WT07a-corruption — Corruption:** Corruption was missing from this rotation and is priority 3 of the archive's Shadow Destruction list, right below the raid curse and above the Shadow Bolt filler: with Improved Corruption it is instant, it costs 35 mana once per target, and it is the only damage-over-time a shadow Destruction warlock keeps up.
- **WT08-immolate — Immolate:** In this file it is not one aura among four, it is the setup for WT05.
- **WT04b-fear-second — Fear:** HO-TKB-PLAY-038 (orchestrator; p1-loop v12 answers OQ-2817): Fear (5782, level 8, 15 per cent of base mana, 1.5 s, 20 yd) on the OTHER attacker, after the DoTs: this rule sits below Agony, Corruption and Immolate, so the kill target carries them first, which is the guide''s order ("DoT both, then Fear the one that is not on you", "Fear B after its DoTs are on", "Fear breaks on new spell applications, not on DoT ticks, so DoT BEFORE you Fear"). The spell has no creature-type mask; a fear-immune creature takes two casts and is then skipped for ten seconds.
- **WT08b-hellfire — Hellfire:** HO-TKB-PLAY-401: threat guard on the target (priority stays 83: a move to 64 waits for a channel stop from p1-loop); amp-6 review: rank 11684 Hellfire is a 296/s periodic self-damage aura (15 s = 172 per cent of a 2.5k warlock), r155 Ithbel cast it at 69 per cent and killed himself six seconds later, so the floor is 90 per cent and, in a party, a healer must be alive and the lowest member at 60 or more. No channel stop exists in the vocabulary, so the aura still runs until another cast ends it; the threat guard reads the current target only.
- **WT11-rain-of-fire — Rain of Fire:** THRESHOLD 4 IS THE ARCHIVE'S OWN: every one of the three warlock playbooks carries `aoe_threshold: 4`, and each puts Rain of Fire there by name -- Affliction "4+ stacked targets; Affliction has no AoE of its own", Demonology "Rain of Fire, condition: pack cleaves", Destruction "Rain of Fire, condition: melee cleave or fire-reflect makes standing in melee unsafe".
- **WT10f-drain-soul-finisher — Drain Soul:** HO-TKB-PLAY-346 (amp-5 review of HO-330, the shard budget; leveling.md L186, L282, L283): Drain Soul on a dying non-boss target, so the warlock gets Soul Shards back the way a human does (finish with Drain Soul when you need shards). Why it is needed: the Soul Shard stacks to 3 (DB item 6265) and the kit carries a stack count agreed with p4-pioneer (2 stacks, 6 shards, for destruction and affliction, 1 stack, 3, for demonology; p4-pioneer change, before the 23:00 CEST regeneration; dropped to one stack if this finisher makes the second unnecessary after a round).
- **WT12w-shoot-trash — Shoot:** HO-TKB-PLAY-065 (owner approved, via the orchestrator: wand earlier on trash, keep the full spells for bosses and big pulls; the warlock ended 10 of 56 round-86 fights under 20 per cent mana): the wand instead of the filler when the target is under 30 per cent health, or the warlock is under 40 per cent mana, in a fight that is not a boss or a big pull (`not (target.ttd_ms >= 15000)`: a target that will take 15 s or more is a long fight, null reads true; `enemies_engaged_within(30) <= 3`: four or more keep the spells; `party.pull_is_boss` is true only while a pull is imminent).
- **WT10a-wand-solo — Shoot:** The guide for 4-9: "Corruption -> Immolate -> wand", from 8 "Curse of Agony -> Corruption -> wand"; and the bot-ready loop: "Nightfall proc -> Shadow Bolt. In a party nothing changes (`not (party.lowest_hp_pct >= 0)` is the solo test the rogue Stealth rule uses).
- **WT12-shoot — Shoot:** Measured on d-20260917T070130Z-p3, actor 358: the wand was 26 per cent of the mage''s casts, 86 per cent of its starts were unasked, 7 ticks were wand-locked, and 35 of its own casts came back SPELL_FAILED_INTERRUPTED -- the bot''s own movement cancelling its own auto-repeat. `not self.moving` is the other half and is the 35 interrupted casts: a wand shot the bot walks out of is a lock bought for nothing.
